stories.title: CyberPanel Pre-Auth RCE Chain Lets Attackers Gain Server Shell via AI Scanner Flaws
stories.description: CyberPanel pre-auth RCE chain lets attackers gain shells on vulnerable servers by abusing AI Scanner flaws, stored XSS, and cron jobs.

stories.title: New “Zombie Card” Flaw Lets Expired Visa Cards Make Contactless Payments
stories.description: A practical NFC relay attack dubbed "Zombie Card" that revives expired Visa contactless cards, allowing them to complete real purchases at point-of-sale terminals across multiple US banks.

stories.title: 15 Malicious Firefox Extensions Abuse Cloudflare Workers to Exfiltrate Crypto Wallet Secrets
stories.description: A Firefox campaign uses fake wallet extensions to steal recovery phrases, private keys, logins and clipboard data from users.
